name: @konstit/csv
description: Bun-native CSV parser with streaming rows, filters, and low-allocation batches.

scripts.setup:cmake: cmake -S . -B build/editor -G Ninja -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && cmake -E copy_if_different build/editor/compile_commands.json compile_commands.json
scripts.build:package: bun run build:dist && bun run verify:native-package
scripts.prebuilds:linux: bun run build:native:linux && bun scripts/stage-native.ts linux-x64
scripts.bench:csv-parser:example: bun run build:native && hyperfine -r 2 --show-output --command-name '@konstit/csv csv.rows() iso88591' 'bun bench/csv-parser/example-file.ts konstit-csv' --command-name 'iconv-lite iso88591 + csv-parser' 'bun bench/csv-parser/example-file.ts csv-parser'
scripts.profile:cpu: bun run build:native && mkdir -p profiles && bun --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir profiles bench/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.profile:cpu:csv-parser: bun run build:native && mkdir -p profiles && bun --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir profiles bench/csv-parser/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.profile:heap: bun run build:native && mkdir -p profiles && bun --heap-prof-md --heap-prof-dir profiles bench/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.profile:heap:csv-parser: bun run build:native && mkdir -p profiles && bun --heap-prof-md --heap-prof-dir profiles bench/csv-parser/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.profile:native-memory: bun run build:native && MIMALLOC_SHOW_STATS=1 bun bench/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.fmt:native: find native bench test -type f -name '*.cpp' -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format -i
scripts.fmt:native:check: find native bench test -type f -name '*.cpp' -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format --dry-run --Werror
scripts.prepush: bun run build:native && bun run build:native:linux && bun run fmt:check && bun run fmt:native:check && bun run lint && bun run test:source-native && bun scripts/test-native.ts
scripts.bench: bun run build:native && bun run scripts/bench.ts
